messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: tooltip for layer_boxplots?
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to add a tooltip to `layer_boxplots`? For example:

library(ggvis)
mtcars %>% ggvis(~cyl, ~mpg) %>% layer_boxplots(width = 0.5)

I would like to be able to click on the two out-layers on the right to get some more information.

Thanks!

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: tooltip for layer_boxplots?
parts:
Probably not at the moment, since boxplots are compound layers made up
of many simpler vega components.
Hadley
